sourceRefs.locator: Description, collection, accession number AE/II/3 (K//1/9), source, permission and image history. The Archives nationales supplied the photograph; the current 1024 × 496 image is oriented for reading.
ARTEM 4507, Archives nationales AE II 3 (K 1 no. 9), regest and ll. 1–4. Petition, brothers, inherited property and Rouergue. Place of issue unidentified. This edition gives 637.

DD Mer. 28, pp. 75–77 (Paris plot); 32, pp. 87–89, especially ll. 3–7 (Ursinus, Beppoleno, maternal estate and mancipia; original ratification dated 629–637); 41, pp. 108–110 (Iticina, probably October 632, possibly into 633); 85, pp. 216–218 (royal privilege).
List of works, section II “Le pouvoir et ses témoignages”, nos. 15–16, catalogue pp. 25–26. Dimensions and date of Clovis II’s charter and the 629–639 range for Dagobert’s AE II 3.

alt.de: Breiter brauner Papyrus auf hellem Grund. Auf die große erste Zeile folgen kleinere Schriftzeilen. Links und nahe der Mitte unterbrechen Lücken das Schriftbild.
alt.en: A wide brown papyrus on a pale mount. Large letters across the top give way to lines in a smaller hand. Gaps interrupt the lines on the left and near the centre.
